---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page, component or copy for "Split It", the bill splitter for Lahore university students.
---

1. Brand name is "Split It", always two words, capital S and I. Tagline: "Eat together. Pay fairly."
2. Tone: a friendly mate who is brilliant at maths. Short sentences, light jokes, never sarcastic or rude. One joke per screen, maximum.
3. Primary colour is Mint Green #2BB673. Accent is Chai Orange #F59E0B. Text is Deep Navy #1F2A44. Background is Soft Cream #FFF9F0. Errors use #E5484D.
4. Headings use Poppins Bold. Body text and numbers use Inter Regular. Load both from Google Fonts with a system sans-serif fallback.
5. Every page must include the logo, the tagline, a header link back to the calculator, and a footer reading "Made for hungry students in Lahore."
6. The calculator needs four inputs in this order: bill amount, number of people, tip percentage and tax percentage. Show the per-person total in large type immediately below them.
7. Write money as "Rs 1,250" with a space and thousands commas. Never use "PKR" or decimals unless paisa are non-zero. Round each share up to the nearest rupee.
8. Write dates as "23 Nov 2026" and times in 12-hour format, like "8:30 pm".
9. Results update live as the user types. No submit button, no page reload, no sign-up.
10. Design mobile-first for a 360px screen. Buttons must be at least 44px tall, and text contrast must meet WCAG AA.
11. Show a short friendly message for invalid input, such as "Hmm, that bill looks empty. Add an amount!"
12. Never store, send or log bill data or any personal details. All calculation happens in the browser only.
